media.description: Images referenced by cards: name (sha256hex.ext) -> base64 bytes

markdown.description: Markdown. Fenced code blocks with a language get syntax highlighting.

id.description: UUID; generated on import when missing

question.description: Front / MCQ stem / typed prompt / ordering prompt / occlusion caption. For cloze: text with {{answer}} or {{answer::hint}} blanks.

answer.description: Back (basic, code, occlusion). For typed: the canonical answer.

correct.description: mcq: indices of correct options. More than one = 'choose N' multiple-response.

option_explanations.description: mcq: why each option is right or wrong (same order as options)

items.description: ordering: steps in the CORRECT order (displayed shuffled)

code.description: code: snippet shown with the question

answer_code.description: code: snippet shown with the answer

language.description: code: highlight language, e.g. yaml, json, bash, python

image.description: occlusion: media name of the base image

masks.description: occlusion: hidden regions, coordinates as fractions of the image size

target.description: occlusion: index of the one mask being tested, or null = all masks

question_images.description: media names shown with the question

answer_images.description: media names shown with the answer

explanation.description: Why the right answer is right AND why each wrong option is wrong

certs.description: cert code -> official domain id, e.g. {"DVA-C02": "1", "SAA-C03": "3"}

tags.description: free topic tags, e.g. lambda, sqs

fsrs.description: Scheduling state (optional on import; omitted = new card)

priority.description: -2..2, AI override; higher = earlier in the queue

leech_help.description: {explanation, learn, videos:[{title,url}]} from the AI leech helper
